description.text:
You will build and run the shared AI platform layer on AWS Bedrock that engineering and business teams use to deliver AI safely and at scale: model gateways, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, evaluation and observability tooling, cost controls and secure configuration templates for AI developer tooling.

Embed security and agent identity: Implement security, privacy and responsible AI controls, including agent identities, delegated authorization and auditable access, in line with Security Architecture standards.  Connect agents to tools and data: Build secure MCP integrations and RAG pipelines connecting agents to internal data and APIs.
